name: Hocheder
beschreibung: Hotel Hocheder is centrally located in Seefeld, not far from the pedestrian zone and the train station. The rooms are mostly equipped with a balcony and mountain view and have cable TV and a safe. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, a sauna, and a steam bath. The restaurant serves breakfast and dinner; half board can be booked. In the surrounding area, guests can hike in summer and go cross-country skiing in winter. Parking is available in the hotel's own garage. The hotel is suitable for guests looking for a quiet location with short distances to the center.
